text:
maria: Hey team, customer flagged a set of PO invoice payments failing with card declines this morning. They say three different cards were declined while attempting the same invoice number. Gateway returned mixed decline reasons. Customer: Acme Logistics (acct: acme-ops). Invoice: INV-2026-389. Can we triage?

sara: Thanks @maria — can you paste the payment token/charge ids and the exact request timestamp? Also did they have PO/Tax fields set?

maria: request_id: req_2026_03_17_0912, charge_ids: [ch_1A2b3, ch_1A2b4, ch_1A2b5]. Invoice had PO: PO-99877 and VAT: not set (merchant in EU). Customer tried retrying twice.

oliver: Pasted gateway response (sanitized):
```
{"charge_id":"ch_1A2b3","status":"declined","decline_code":"do_not_honor","risk_score":86,"3ds":"required","message":"Transaction declined by issuer for suspected fraud"}
```

luis: Risk_score 86 is high. Looks like acquirer marked as potential fraud/velocity. Also 3DS flagged as required but the flow is server-side invoice capture — we never surfaced a 3DS challenge to the buyer. That would cause issuer-level decline.

sara: Customer is seeing repeated declines and then auto-retries causing multiple holds. Recommend disabling auto-retry for that merchant until we clear the root cause. @oliver can you confirm our redirect/3DS handling for invoice-hosted checkout?

oliver: Confirmed — invoice-hosted should trigger a 3DS redirect when the acquirer sets `3ds_required`. I see in logs that our handler received the signal but the redirect URL returned 502 from their CDN for 2 of the 3 attempts: `POST /checkout/3ds -> 502` which likely caused the incomplete 3DS flow.

james: So flow is: issuer requests challenge, our checkout should redirect buyer to challenge, CDN error -> challenge not completed -> issuer declines. That explains mix of `do_not_honor` and `3ds_required` responses.

sara: Immediate steps: 1) Disable auto-retry for Acme to avoid extra holds. 2) Open ops ticket with CDN provider for the 502s on our hosted-checkout path. 3) Advise customer to collect an alternate payment method if they need immediate settlement. 4) Attempt a manual capture with 3DS completed (if customer can complete challenge).

maria: I told the customer we disabled auto-retry and asked them to provide a backup card. They're asking if this can be prevented — they also mentioned some transactions showed `insufficient_funds` as well earlier today.

oliver: Those could be separate: one card actually had insufficient funds, others failed due to 3DS/velocity. We should tag each decline cause in the invoice UI and add a note for merchants about 3DS-required invoices and PO/VAT mismatch.

incident-bot: New ops ticket created: OPS-5834 — Investigate 502 on hosted-checkout/3ds (assigned to eng-infra).

luis: I'll add a temporary autoscaling rule for the checkout CDN path and increase retry timeout for the 3ds redirect to reduce hits while infra investigates.

sara: Support follow-up: I'll message Acme with a summary and ETA for ops ticket. Also asking them to enable VAT/PO fields on invoices (they were missing VAT lines) — EU acquirers often check invoice tax metadata which can affect risk checks.

maria: Thanks team. I'll keep the thread updated once Acme sends backup card or completes challenge. :thumbsup:
